title: Medical and Social Heat Outreach Assessment
intended_use: Prioritize preventive heat outreach for adults with confirmed hypertension by combining a patient vulnerability score with the official NWS HeatRisk category.
not_intended_for: diagnosing or ruling out heat-related illness
estimating an individual's probability of harm
recommending changes to prescribed fluid limits
replacing clinical judgment or emergency evaluation

scope.geography: United States ZIP codes supported by the NWS NDFD service
scope.patient_identifier_policy: Use a non-empty pseudonymous identifier; do not send patient information to the forecast service.

scoring.unknown_value_policy: Calculate minimum and maximum possible domain scores; never interpret unknown as no.

domains.label: Clinical susceptibility
domains.rule: Add one point for each present factor, then cap the domain at 2.

domains.label: Medication considerations

rules.condition: Medication review is complete and no mapped heat-relevant class is present.
At least one mapped heat-relevant class is present.
A DIURETIC is present with an ACEI, ARB, or ARNI.

domains.incomplete_review_policy: When the medication list is missing, incomplete, or contains an unmapped entry, retain the highest score still possible.

domains.label: Cooling access

rules.condition: Reliable home cooling is unavailable, but a confirmed usable alternative cooling location is available.
Neither reliable home cooling nor a confirmed usable alternative cooling location is available.

domains.usable_alternative_definition: Opening hours, transportation, affordability, and accessibility are workable for the patient.

domains.label: Support and assistance
domains.rule: Add one point for each present factor.
domains.living_alone_policy: Living alone is not scored by itself; assess actual check-in support and assistance needs.

scoring.combination_policy: Keep NWS HeatRisk H separate from patient vulnerability V; never add H and V together.

symptom_policy.normalization: Trim, lowercase, replace non-alphanumeric runs with underscores, collapse repeated underscores, and remove leading or trailing underscores.
symptom_policy.unrecognized_nonempty_policy: Route any reported, non-empty symptom that is not in a configured list to prompt clinical review.
symptom_policy.not_assessed_policy: State that symptoms were not assessed and that the preventive assessment does not rule out heat illness.

MAINTAIN_HEAT_PLAN.label: Maintain heat plan
MAINTAIN_HEAT_PLAN.description: Keep the existing prevention plan ready and monitor verified forecasts.

CONFIRM_COOLING_PLAN.label: Confirm cooling plan
CONFIRM_COOLING_PLAN.description: Confirm reliable home cooling or a usable alternative location, including hours, transportation, affordability, and accessibility.

REDUCE_HEAT_EXPOSURE.label: Reduce heat exposure
REDUCE_HEAT_EXPOSURE.description: Review practical ways to reduce heat exposure and strenuous activity and to use cooling breaks.

ARRANGE_CHECKIN.label: Arrange check-in
ARRANGE_CHECKIN.description: Arrange reliable check-ins and any assistance needed to carry out the heat-safety plan.

REVIEW_EXISTING_HEAT_PLAN.label: Review existing heat plan
REVIEW_EXISTING_HEAT_PLAN.description: Review the patient's existing heat plan, symptom instructions, medication safety message, and prescribed fluid limits.

CARE_TEAM_REVIEW.label: Care-team review
CARE_TEAM_REVIEW.description: Flag the assessment for care-team review before the forecast heat period; this is not an emergency diagnosis.

action_personalization.remove_REDUCE_HEAT_EXPOSURE_when: expected_heat_exposure is false and has_strenuous_heat_exposure is false
action_personalization.remove_ARRANGE_CHECKIN_when: has_reliable_checkin_support is true and needs_assistance_for_heat_protection is false
action_personalization.priority_invariance: Personalization may remove inapplicable actions only after priority is selected; it cannot change the score, score range, status, or priority.

messages.routine: Routine outreach: maintain the existing heat plan.
messages.targeted: Targeted outreach: provide personalized prevention and support checks.
messages.priority: Priority outreach: flag for care-team review before the forecast heat period. This is not an emergency diagnosis.
messages.forecast_unavailable: Official HeatRisk is unavailable. Keep the heat plan ready and reassess when a verified forecast is available.
messages.needs_information: More information is needed because the score range changes outreach priority.
messages.emergency: Call 911 now (US). Move to a cooler place and begin cooling while help arrives. Do not give fluids to an unconscious person.
messages.symptom_review: Move to a cooler place and contact a clinician or urgent care for prompt assessment. Seek prompt care for vomiting or worsening symptoms. Call 911 for confusion, seizure, or loss of consciousness.
messages.safety: Do not change medications or prescribed fluid limits based on this tool.

forecast_policy.source: NWS National Digital Forecast Database XML service
forecast_policy.failure_policy: Return forecast_unavailable; never substitute HeatRisk 0 for a missing, stale, malformed, mismatched, or out-of-range forecast.
